Instead of having to compute n nested integrals repeatedly, we can compute the following single integral
![[10 cauchy's formula for repeated integration-cauchy's formula for repeated integration.jpg]]
This represents the same integral nested n times

- can be paired with the [[gamma function]], to calculate nested integrals when n isn't a whole number
